Design a landing page like tinte
GitHub - Railly/tinte: Compile your design system into an Agent Plugin.

name: tinte
summary: CLI and web tool that extracts a design system from a live site and compiles it into an Agent Plugin plus editor and terminal themes.
description: Reads computed styles from a page you already trust, normalizes them into thirteen semantic OKLCH tokens, and emits a SKILL.md + tokens.css Agent Plugin that coding agents install into .agents/skills/. The same config compiles themes for VS Code, Zed, kitty, Warp, Alacritty, Windows Terminal, Slack, GIMP and Shiki, and a linter fails the build on colors that bypass the tokens.
contains: extracts computed styles from a live page into 13 semantic OKLCH tokens
emits SKILL.md + tokens.css as an installable Agent Plugin
lints hex literals and framework palette classes, exits 1 on defects
compiles themes for 9 targets: vscode, zed, kitty, warp, alacritty, windows-terminal, slack, gimp, shiki
every public theme installable as a shadcn registry:base item
500+ syntax themes and PNG/SVG screenshot export via Ray (ray.tinte.dev)
site serves its own /design.md, /tokens.css and plugin tree
